standard_prerequisites.name: For a type of algebraic structure (C, F): F preserves fibre products and reflects isomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the identification F(A times_B C) = F(A) and the conclusion A = A times_B C.

core_obligations: Form the fibre product A times_B C with projections to A and C (proof lines 1493-1494). Since F preserves fibre products, F(A times_B C) = F(A) times_{F(B)} F(C), and the inclusion Im(F(f)) subset Im(F(g)) with F(g) injective makes this fibre product equal F(A) (proof lines 1493-1495). The projection A times_B C -> A is therefore an isomorphism after F; because F reflects isomorphisms, A = A times_B C, and the composite of the projection to C with the inverse identification gives t with f = g composition t (proof lines 1495-1496).
proof_roadmap: Form A times_B C and compute its F-image (proof lines 1493-1495).
Reflect the isomorphism back to C and read off the factorization t (proof lines 1495-1496).
